name: LANES_MERGE_YELLOW_DIAMOND

nsw_w5-235-1n_merge.desc: two lanes merging into one arrow, 275 x 867 (symbol detail on the sheet's 36 grid)

notes: TfNSW design plan (Roads & Maritime 2019 style, upright A3 sheet). 900 diamond (side 900, bounding square 1272.79), R60, yellow edge 12, black border 24 (the sheet's 12 and 36 marks at the tips; measured 12 / 28). Symbol 275 x 867 at 501 / 164 (ink box measured on the sheet's sign from the diamond's bounding square; the red-bar symbols' boxes take the red bar's measured extent, which is longer than the arrows; the bus box is the traced extent), traced from the sheet's sign. Sheet W5-235-1n: C labelled '1200 x 1200' but drawn as the 900 diamond (see W5-235n).
